title: 开发进度缓慢且内容不完整
description: 游戏开发进度缓慢，关键功能缺失，内容不完整，玩家等待时间久。
evidence: With the development cycle being as absolutely glacial as it is, I just can't recommend it. This was "released," in 2020, and we're just getting the ability to be able to label our containers in-game.
4 years, half way there, only 50 % are done (maybe), don't wast you time, update very slow

evidence_items.quote: With the development cycle being as absolutely glacial as it is, I just can't recommend it. This was "released," in 2020, and we're just getting the ability to be able to label our containers in-game.
evidence_items.description: 开发进度极其缓慢，5年才添加容器标签功能。
evidence_items.quote_zh: 由于开发周期绝对像冰川一样缓慢，我实在无法推荐它。这款游戏是在2020年“发行”的，而我们现在才刚刚获得在游戏内给容器贴标签的能力。

evidence_items.quote: Development is much too slow for what is being implemented.
evidence_items.quote_zh: 相对于实际实现的内容，开发进度实在太慢了。

evidence_items.quote_zh: 4年了，才走了一半，只有50%完成了（也许吧），别浪费时间，更新非常慢
